pages.text: A new miner! I can smell the dust on you already. &6Tamsin Deepholt&r, Deepholt Delving Co. Hollis sent you. Hollis always sends the nice ones.

&6Mining&r is the first trade. Every ore you break gives &6Mining XP&r. Level up and you unlock better pickaxes, ores and armour. My shop sells &6nodes&r, tools and gear, paid in &6Glimmer Shards&r, which every ore drops.

A tip: ores in the wild give far more XP than nodes. Nodes are for practice: they go dark when mined and regrow after a while. And some ores need a better pickaxe to crack. The tier is on the tooltip.
Take this stone pickaxe, and come back once you've seen the wild. I'll have real work for you. Oswin the forager is next: west of the square, by the trees. Hard to miss. Easy to hear.
